entries.failure_mode: MG ambiguous abbreviation (Müller glia vs microglia) collides across systems, bare writing in deliverables causes naming ambiguity
entries.observable_signature: Same abbreviation points to different classes in different systems (CL back-check: CL:0000636=Müller cell)
entries.mitigation: Prohibit bare 'MG' in any deliverable—always use Müller glia / microglia full names or CL number anchoring (this library's CL:0000636=Müller cell is the correct solution verified via OLS number-by-number back-check in KB5v3, Astro=CL:0000127; citing other libraries' CL numbers requires OLS back-check, memory prohibited).
